## Full-stack toolkit
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS, responsive UI.
- Backend: Node.js, NestJS microservices, Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, GraphQL, Stripe payment integrations, n8n workflows.
- Data and infrastructure: Redis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse, vector databases, Pinecone, AWS deployment, Docker.
- Applied AI: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, RAG pipelines, embeddings, AI agents, multi-agent architecture, LLM observability, and LLM evaluation.

## Selected work
- [Growstack AI](/projects/growstack/): Priyansh built the Python analytics backend for LangGraph filter extraction, ClickHouse querying, previews, and tracked exports.
- [uRecruits](/projects/urecruits/): Priyansh built the NestJS multi-agent service, with supervisor routing to specialist job, workflow, assessment, interview-scheduling, and guidance agents.
- [Zyberon AI](/projects/zyberon/): Priyansh built the Shopify automation platform from scratch, connecting a Next.js dashboard, Supabase, n8n, Gemini, Shopify, Meta, and Stripe workflows.
- [AI Voice Agent](/projects/voice-agent/): Lead qualification, appointment scheduling, context handling, and follow-ups using Retell AI, FastAPI, and MongoDB.
- [MyChatPDF](/projects/mychatpdf/): Document processing, retrieval-backed chat, previews, and organization. React, FastAPI.
- [AI Workforce Engine](/projects/workforce-engine/): Declarative specialist agents, routing, scoped memory, and human escalation. FastAPI, Redis, Qdrant.
- [Top Cars Sales Agent](/projects/top-cars-n8n/): n8n lead routing across automotive-service sub-workflows and CRM context.
- [Hotel Social Media Agent](/projects/hotel-social-n8n/): n8n social-event normalization, rule-first triage, draft generation, and Slack approval.
- [EPulse Event Discovery](/projects/epulse-discovery/): Sourced event extraction, validation, deduplication, and Google Sheets review.
- [Trading Strategy & Execution Engine](/projects/trading-engine/): Execution readiness gates, market-feed parity checks, durable state, and broker reconciliation.
- [SketchAPaw](/projects/sketchapaw/): Guided pet-photo personalization, AI portrait preview jobs, Shopify checkout, and artwork review.
